===[[Ashanti Region]]===
[[Image:Districts of the Ashanti Region (2012).svg|thumb|right|500px|Districts of the Ashanti Region]]
The Ashanti Region of Ghana is made up of 43 districts.<ref name="summary">{{cite web |title=Ghana Districts: A repository of all Local Assemblies in Ghana |url=http://www.ghanadistricts.com/Home/LinkData/8239 |website=www.ghanadistricts.com |access-date=20 December 2020}}</ref> This was increased from 30 districts.
